title: 第15章 误打误撞
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
激情下单一晚上，卡里的余额变化也不是很大，花期早上是笑着醒来的。

    她睁眼的第一瞬间，便打开终端查看配送进度。

    大型快递都到了，小的也在路上了，最远的明天到。

    花期手头宽松了，便在麦麦家下单了豪华早餐，还有肯肯家的汉堡蛋挞。

    随后火速起床跑去洗漱换衣服，推开大门外卖和快递正好一同送来。

    除了这些，一人一鼠也到了。

    城主府大门被一大堆箱子堆得没地方落脚，她们谨慎搬移箱子，避免源源不断送来的盒子被碰到。

    荣华前天看到过这些箱子，名叫快递，是城主大人变出来的，所以看到也没过多惊慌。

    松松没看到过，一离开树林来到城主府，睁眼就是被挡住的去路。

    它满眼好奇地在纸箱子上摸了又摸，还贴在箱子上闻了闻。

    荣华轻声对它说：“松松，这是大人的箱子，我们小心点。”

    松松听不懂荣华说话，但能感觉得到箱子应该是花期的东西。

    它敏捷地踩着箱子跳出快递山，一出去看到城主府大门打开，花期走了出来。

    “大人，俺来了。”

    花期今日穿了件防晒衣和休闲裤，头上戴着帽子，长长的卷发被扎成高马尾，身上充满了活泼气息。

    她出门首先看到的是朝她飞来的机器人，签收了外卖和快递，随后才看到跳出来的松松以及爬出来的荣华。

    “刚好赶上早饭，进来吃饭吧！”

    荣华对她行了一礼，恭敬地点下头，“遵命大人。”

    她轻轻提着裙角，迈着小碎步跟上花期。

    松松是第一次进入城主府，它站在宽阔的院子内，望着院内的布置哇了一声。

    “大人，这是您的洞府吗？真大。”

    蓝蓝的天，高高的树叶，地上还有干净的水源。

    这是仙境吧！

    “这算什么大，等你把古城转完才知道啥叫大，快来吃饭。”

    花期把早餐放在桌上，荣华立马接过她的活。
content_en:
After a single night of passion, the balance in the card did not change much. I woke up with a smile in the morning.

    The first moment she opened her eyes, she opened the terminal to check the delivery progress.

    The large express delivery has arrived, the small one is on the way, and the farthest one will arrive tomorrow.

    Huaqi had some money, so she ordered a luxurious breakfast at Maimai's house, as well as hamburgers and egg tarts from Kenken's house.

    Then I got up quickly and ran to wash up and change clothes. I opened the door and the takeout and express delivery happened to be delivered together.

    In addition to these, a man and a mouse also arrived.

    The gate of the city lord's mansion was piled with so many boxes that there was no place to stay. They moved the boxes carefully to avoid being hit by the boxes that were constantly being delivered.

    Ronghua had seen these boxes the day before yesterday. They were called express delivery and were conjured up by the city lord, so he didn't panic too much when he saw them.

    Songsong had never seen it before. As soon as he left the woods and came to the city lord's mansion, he saw that the way was blocked when he opened his eyes.

    It touched the cardboard box again and again with curiosity, and even stuck it to the box and smelled it.

    Ronghua said to it softly: "Songsong, this is the adult's box, let's be careful."

    Songsong couldn't understand Ronghua's words, but he could feel that the box should be something from the flower period.

    It nimbly stepped on the box and jumped out of the courier mountain. As soon as it went out, it saw the door of the city lord's mansion opened, and Hua Qi walked out.

    "Sir, I'm here."

    Today, Hua Qi wore a sun protection jacket, casual pants, a hat on her head, her long curly hair tied into a high ponytail, and her body was full of liveliness.

    The first thing she saw when she went out was the robot flying towards her, signing for the takeout and express delivery, and then she saw Songsong jumping out and Ronghua climbing out.

    "Just in time for breakfast, come in and eat!"

    Ronghua saluted her and nodded respectfully, "My lord."

    She gently lifted the hem of her skirt and took small steps to keep up with the flowering period.

    It was the first time for Songsong to enter the city lord's mansion. He stood in the wide courtyard and let out a cry while looking at the layout of the courtyard.

    "Sir, is this your cave? It's really big."

    The blue sky, the tall leaves, and the clean water on the ground.

    This is wonderland!

    "This is nothing big. You won't know what big is until you finish walking around the ancient city. Come and have a meal."

    Huaqi put breakfast on the table, and Ronghua immediately took over her work.
